== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-solomahal-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Solomahal]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Solomahal (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “any” becomes “your”; “'''scout'''” becomes “scout”; “now” is dropped; “to an adjacent site” is dropped; “any” becomes “your”; “That” becomes “When that”; “'reacts,' it” is added after “scout. That scout”; “when 'reacting.'” becomes “for remainder of turn.”. These are the same words as [[Solomahal (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Solomahal” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
